root.command: SELECT c.ContactID, c.CompanyName, it.InvoiceTypeDesc AS AccountType, rit.InvoiceTypeDesc AS RecurringFlag FROM dbo.ContactsAccInfoTbl a INNER JOIN dbo.ContactsTbl c ON c.ContactID = a.ContactID INNER JOIN dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl it ON it.InvoiceTypeID = a.InvoiceTypeID CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 r.InvoiceTypeID FROM dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl r WHERE r.ContactID = a.ContactID AND ISNULL(r.Enabled, 0) = 1 ORDER BY r.RecurringOrderID ) ro LEFT JOIN dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl rit ON rit.InvoiceTypeID = ro.InvoiceTypeID WHERE a.InvoiceTypeID IN (2, 3) ORDER BY c.CompanyName;
